title: Essay 1: Should cities ban cars from downtown cores?
prompt: Write a 400-700 word argumentative essay taking a clear position on whether mid-sized cities should ban private cars from their downtown cores. Support your position with evidence and address at least one counterargument.

rubric.description: Clear, arguable position stated early and maintained throughout.
Specific, relevant, credible support for each claim.
Fairly presents at least one opposing view and rebuts it.
Logical structure, paragraphs with clear focus, effective transitions.
Grammar, spelling, punctuation, and word count within range.
